Turn a boring chart into a moving explainer, just by asking.
In Claude, choose Output, then Motion. Type: animate my sales chart, with each bar growing in sequence.
Claude writes code that moves your graphics. Watch the bars rise, the labels appear, and the takeaway land.
Need a change? Ask Claude to highlight the last bar in coral. The color changes while the rest stays put.
Then export your animation as an MP4. Motion is in beta for Team and Enterprise; Enterprise owners may need to enable it.
